definitions.gloss: savory bun; savory filled or topped bread
definitions.explanation: Bread filled or topped with savory food such as curry, sausage, yakisoba or croquettes, sold at bakeries and convenience stores; the savory counterpart of {菓子|かし}パン.

examples.japanese: {総菜|そうざい}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総菜|そうざい}パン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I made do with a savory bun for lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦カレーパン→カレーパン：31844_kareepan⟧や⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン{屋|や}→パン屋：19415_panya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総菜|そうざい}パン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese bakeries have many savory buns, such as curry bread and yakisoba bread.

notes:
Also written ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧. A typical Japanese bakery item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦カレーパン→カレーパン：31844_kareepan⟧: curry bread
- ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: yakisoba in a hot-dog bun
- コロッケパン: croquette sandwich

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{菓子|かし}パン→菓子パン：32225_kashipan⟧: sweet bun — the sweet counterpart (⟦メロンパン→メロンパン：28780_meronpan⟧, ⟦あんパン→あんパン：31170_anpan⟧)
- ⟦{総菜|そうざい}→総菜：16739_souzai⟧: prepared side dish — the first part of the word
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: bread
